results.title: Dialysis services commence at Lima Regional Hospital
results.description: Residents across Region Two (Pomeroon-Supenaam), who require dialysis treatment, will no longer have to travel to receive the life-saving service as the Lima Regional Hospital rolls out dialysis services. There are approximately 12 patients in the region who require this treatment. Previously, they had to travel to Regions Three and Four to access dialysis. results.title: Can you get flesh-eating bacteria from eating seafood or oysters?
results.description: Dr. William Schaffner said people with liver disease or who are immunocompromised should avoid eating raw oysters.
